messages:
Priya (Billing): Noticed a bad pattern in the March invoice export: VAT appearing twice on several EU invoices when reserved_capacity credits are present. Some invoices ended up with negative balances.
Jordan (Eng): ack. Which job produced them?
Priya (Billing): job invoice-run-2026-03-22-21. Sample extracted from pipeline logs:
```
lines:
  - reserved_capacity_credit: -200.00
  - usage_compute: 200.00
  - vat: 0.00
  - vat: 40.00
```
Priya (Billing): Looks like credits hit before tax calc in the billing service but the tax-service also re-applied tax on the gross path, creating two VAT entries.
billing-bot: invoice-run-2026-03-22-21 completed with 28 warnings and 6 errors. Key errors: TAX_DUPLICATE, EXPORT_BLOCKED.
Ruth (RevOps): Do we have duplicates across separate invoices or just duplicate tax lines on the same invoice?
Priya (Billing): Same invoice, duplicate VAT entries. 14 EU customers affected; 2 are enterprise with reserved capacity. A few invoices show final balance -40.00 which Stripe may reject.
Noah (Payments): If Stripe rejects, we'll get draft invoices stuck and possible webhook churn. Suggest pausing auto-export until we triage.
Jordan (Eng): I can push a conservative guard: exporter rejects invoices with negative final totals and flags them for manual review. Will open a PR.
Priya (Billing): Please pause exports for March batch. Finance will not issue statements until we fix. We also need a list of affected invoices so Sales can notify customers.
Ruth (RevOps): Once fixed, we should re-run exports with idempotency keys. But we may need to create credit memos for any customers who were overbilled.
Jordan (Eng): Root cause seems to be a race between "apply_credits" and "calculate_taxes" microservices. Immediate mitigation: make tax calculation single-sourced (only tax-service computes, consuming final net line items) and dedupe any tax lines by code before finalizing invoice.
Noah (Payments): After patch, will re-export only the impacted invoice ids. Stripe idempotency should help but QA will need to confirm drafts vs finalized invoices.
Priya (Billing): I'll compile the CSV of affected invoice ids and contact owners. Target: notify customers within 24h and complete remediation in 48h.
Ruth (RevOps): @Jordan add unit test asserting total == sum(lines) + sum(taxes) and no negative taxes.
Jordan (Eng): adding tests and a staging canary. Quick guard deployed in ~2h, full fix tomorrow morning.
Priya (Billing): Thanks everyone. Holding exports now. I'll post the customer message draft in ~90 mins. :pray:
